screening_note: This memo prepares an investment decision from public sources. It does not make one.
sec_options_screening: What would have to be true
sec_open_questions: Open questions for the partner meeting
disclaimer: This report uses public sources only. It is not insight into any company's internals.
confidential: Confidential. This report contains non-public information. Do not share or publish it.
disclaimer_private: This report combines public sources with non-public material supplied by its user.
compliance_public: All sources in this report are publicly available.
compliance_private: Non-public sources were supplied by the report's user, who has stated for each one who supplied it and on what basis it may be used.
confidence_high: High confidence: several independent sources agree.
confidence_medium: Medium confidence: the evidence points one way but has gaps.
confidence_low: Low confidence: the evidence is thin or conflicting.
sec_legend: How to read the confidence words
illustrative: Illustrative only. This report was made with an invented company pack as practice material. Nothing in it is a finding about a real company.
no_facts: No fact could be confirmed from the sources that were read.
not_comparable: These figures are stated in different units and cannot be compared.
framing_company: Question taken from the company's own public statements.
framing_user: Question framed by the author of this report, not by the company.
rec_none: No recommendation was made: the advisor did not run, or its list was refused twice by the program's form check.
rec_damaged: No recommendation can be shown: the lens recommendation file of this run is damaged, so it can no longer be read as it was made.
rec_damaged_parts: Parts of this list were changed after the program wrote it, so they are not as the advisor made them. Each such part is marked where it stands; the rest is shown as it was made.
rec_flag_changed: {part} was changed after the program wrote it, so it is not as the advisor wrote it.
rec_flag_unreadable: {part} cannot be read: it was changed after the program wrote it.
rec_flag_extra: It holds a part the program does not write: it was changed after the program wrote it.
rec_flag_entry: The lens in place {n} of the advisor's list cannot be read: it was changed after the program wrote it.
rec_flag_verdict: A reader's verdict cannot be read, and neither can the link it was about: it was changed after the program wrote it.
rec_flag_verdict_elsewhere: A reader's verdict on a link this list does not hold cannot be read: it was changed after the program wrote it.
rec_flag_stale_unknown: Whether this list still fits the facts cannot be told: what it saw of the facts was changed after the program wrote it.
rec_partname_by: The name of who made it
mark_unreadable: A reader's verdict on this link cannot be read: it was changed after the program wrote it.
rec_stale: This list was made before the facts changed: it was made for other facts than the ones this report rests on, so it was not the current list at the final decision. It is shown as it was made.
rec_helpers: Helpers set to: {models}; a setting on the computer of the person who ran it can override a helper's model
mark_doubt: {reader} doubts that this fact bears on the lens: {note}
mark_doubt_plain: {reader} doubts that this fact bears on the lens.
mark_bears: {reader} found that this fact bears on the lens.
mark_bears_note: {reader} found that this fact bears on the lens: {note}
rests_on_invented: Invented for practice: this lens rests on no real work.
internal_questions: Questions only the company can answer
access_captive: Captive: for the company's own use
none_projects: This run found no capacity moves to group.
none_connections: This run recorded no customers, partners, sellers or buyers.
none_connections_dropped: This run recorded customers, partners, sellers or buyers, but no quote names them, so none are shown.
none_connections_old: Runs made before connections were recorded do not have them.
none_timeline: This run found no capacity moves to place on a timeline.
none_options: The analysis lists no decision options, open questions or things to watch.
none_checks: The bias audit recorded no findings, the analysis lists nothing it could not confirm, and no fact was rejected.
none_thinking: The analysis names no lens, so there is no thinking behind it to show.
none_changes: The comparison with the last run recorded no changes.
none_messages: The analysis states no key messages.
supporting_repeats: This source repeats {source}, the fact's own source, so it is not a second source.
early_signals_note: Early signals are hints such as building permits, job postings and regulator records. They are not announcements, and each one is marked uncertain.
changes_not_found_note: This does not mean the plan was withdrawn. No source says so.
reason_not_found: The quote was not found in the saved source.
reason_not_supported: The checker judged that the quote does not support the fact.
reason_quote_too_short: The quote is too short to check.
reason_quote_too_long: The quote is longer than allowed.
reason_no_saved_copy: There is no saved copy of the source to check against.
reason_supporting_quote_not_found: A supporting quote was not found in its source.
reason_checks_incomplete: The checks of this fact are not complete.
reason_support_check_outdated: The fact was changed after its support check.
access_reason_timeout: The site did not answer in time.
access_reason_network_error: The site could not be reached.
access_reason_certificate_failed: The site's certificate could not be checked. On a Mac with Python from python.org, run its Install Certificates command, or set RADAR_PYTHON to another Python.
access_reason_too_large: The file is too large to save.
access_reason_unsupported_type: The file is not a web page or a PDF with text.
access_reason_no_text_layer: The PDF has no text to read; it may be a scan.
access_reason_unreadable_file: The file could not be read.
access_reason_too_little_text: The page has too little text to quote from.
access_reason_login_required: The page asks for a login.
access_reason_robots: The site does not allow automatic saving of this page.
access_reason_private_address: The address points inside a private network, so it was not opened.
access_reason_too_many_redirects: The site sent the request on too many times.
text_note_little_running_text: The saved copy holds little running text, so the page's article may be missing. Save the page as a PDF and add it as a file.
source_passed_on: The site passed the request on, and this copy was saved from
source_saved_from: Saved from (the site passed the request on)
sec_answer: Who is the new capacity for?
answer_outside: {n} more moves were found that fall outside the question.
answer_outside_one: {n} more move was found that falls outside the question.
company_only_connections: appears only as a customer, partner, seller or buyer
answer_note: Counted by project. The grouping into projects is a model's judgement; the program checked only that each move sits in one project, and that a project holds one company and one country.
answer_rule: A project counts as open to customers when at least one of its reports says so and none says it is for own use; as for own use the same way round; as reports disagree when both appear; otherwise as not stated.
answer_ungrouped_none: No grouping into projects was made for this run, so every move counts as its own project.
answer_ungrouped_damaged: The record that groups the moves into projects is damaged and cannot be read, so every move counts as its own project.
answer_ungrouped_outdated: The grouping into projects no longer fits the facts, because a fact was added or withdrawn after it was made, so every move counts as its own project.
single_source_note: One source states it, and that source is not the company itself. No second, independent source was found.
names_dropped: {companies} company names and {parties} names of other parties were not found in their quotes, so they are not shown.
how_counting: How the projects and the answer were counted
filter_count_some: Showing {shown} of {n}; {hidden} hidden by the filter
company_head_note: This page is the full report, filtered to this company. Nothing on it is new: go back to see everything again.
